signs.name: Solid perception
signs.gloss: all images revolve around a central and privileged image
signs.q: Whose world is this?

signs.name: Liquid perception
signs.gloss: the flow from character/event to character/event
signs.q: Does perception migrate?

signs.name: Gaseous perception
signs.gloss: all images resonate with one another as an acentred system
signs.q: Can the world perceive without a human center?

signs.name: Icon
signs.gloss: the face expressing unfilmable internal intensities
signs.q: Where does intensity become a face?

signs.name: Dividual
signs.gloss: the conjunction of collective and individual affects
signs.q: Is the feeling mine, ours, or both?

signs.name: Any-space-whatever
signs.gloss: the expression of non-human affects
signs.q: Has place stopped functioning as ordinary geography?

signs.name: Symptom
signs.gloss: characters overwhelmed by primal forces
signs.q: What force is acting through this body?

signs.name: Fetish
signs.gloss: a special object charged with primal energies, awaiting a grounding
signs.q: What object has become charged?

signs.name: Originary world
signs.gloss: a universe of primal forces
signs.q: What ancient or pre-social force underlies this milieu?

signs.name: Index of lack
signs.gloss: the situation is an ellipsis which is unequivocally revealed
signs.q: What missing situation does this action let us infer?

signs.name: Index of equivocity
signs.gloss: the situation is revealed as ambiguous
signs.q: What two worlds could explain the same action?

signs.name: Vector
signs.gloss: multiple situations within the homogeneous universe
signs.q: How do several incomplete situations compose a world?

signs.name: Milieu
signs.gloss: the situation explicated through character actions
signs.q: What world produces these actions?

signs.name: Binomial
signs.gloss: a whole world of duels
signs.q: Where has the world become a duel?

signs.name: Imprint
signs.gloss: an indelible impression of the world upon a character
signs.q: How has the world gotten inside the character?

signs.name: Plastic figure
signs.gloss: small form transformed by the large form, an implied situation
signs.q: What greater situation does this action unexpectedly imply?

signs.name: Theatrical figure
signs.gloss: a sequence of images as precursor of the real action
signs.q: What real action is being rehearsed through fiction?

signs.name: Mise en abyme
signs.gloss: a recurrence of plastic and theatrical figures
signs.q: Is one action-world nested inside another?

signs.name: Figure of the sublime
signs.gloss: actions surpass the determinates of an enfeebled situation
signs.q: Is the action bigger than the world requires?

signs.name: Figure of enfeeblement
signs.gloss: weak characters reveal the sublime nature of the world
signs.q: Is the actor tiny compared with the world disclosed?

signs.name: Quotidian
signs.gloss: everyday situations, everyday actions – sublime ↔ futile
signs.q: Has everyday life become both ridiculous and heroic?

signs.name: Limit of the large form action-image
signs.gloss: action explores a hidden problem
signs.q: What hidden question does this world contain?

signs.name: Limit of the small form action-image
signs.gloss: the situation revealed as a problem
signs.q: Why do the clues refuse to settle the situation?

signs.name: Limit of the action-image (extreme limit)
signs.gloss: a whole world of problems
signs.q: Has action itself stopped being an adequate solution?

signs.name: Rich dream
signs.gloss: radically distinct real world and dream world
signs.q: Can we clearly tell when the dream begins?

signs.name: Restrained dream
signs.gloss: an ambiguity between real world and dream world
signs.q: Are we unsure whether waking has ended?

signs.name: Movement of world
signs.gloss: the dream world is the real world
signs.q: What if nobody ever wakes up?

signs.name: Strong destiny
signs.gloss: a flashback to the past determines the future
signs.q: Does the remembered past command what happens next?

signs.name: Weak destiny
signs.gloss: the content of the flashback permeates affects
signs.q: Does memory color the present without dictating it?

signs.name: Forking paths
signs.gloss: a matrix of irresolvable flashbacks
signs.q: Which past, if any, actually explains the present?

signs.name: Mark
signs.gloss: the relation between a habitual series of images
signs.q: What recurring thing has become meaningful because it repeats?

signs.name: Demark
signs.gloss: an aberration in the series of habitual images
signs.q: What breaks the pattern?

signs.name: Symbol
signs.gloss: an object expressing ideas, beliefs, concepts
signs.q: What idea is being thought through this thing?

signs.name: Opsign
signs.gloss: the zeroness of the time-image: a pure optical situation
signs.q: Can this sight still be discharged into action?
signs.type: Opsign / pure actual optical situation (zeroness of the time-image, optical side)

signs.name: Sonsign
signs.gloss: the zeroness of the time-image: a pure sound situation
signs.q: Does this sound stand alone as a situation, answered by no action?
signs.type: Sonsign / pure actual sound situation (zeroness of the time-image, sound side)

signs.name: Mirrors face to face
signs.gloss: fragments, duplicates and distortions
signs.q: Which image is original?

signs.name: Limpid and opaque
signs.gloss: the exchange of the actual and virtual
signs.q: Which side of the image is becoming real?

signs.name: Seed and environment
signs.gloss: (virtual/actual) seed ↔ (actual/virtual) environment
signs.q: What future world lies virtually inside this image?

signs.name: Peaks of the present
signs.gloss: the heterogeneous present
signs.q: What if several presents are simultaneously valid?

signs.name: Sheets of the past
signs.gloss: the non-chronological nature of the past
signs.q: Which layer of the past are we inhabiting?

signs.name: Powers of the false
signs.gloss: serialism, the ongoing ungrounding of the image
signs.q: What if contradiction generates rather than obstructs the story?

signs.name: Bodies of attitude
signs.gloss: a dispersed individuation of the body
signs.q: What does the body think before it acts?

signs.name: Bodies of gest
signs.gloss: the linkage of attitudes creating differentiation
signs.q: How do postures become social relations?

signs.name: Cinema of the brain
signs.gloss: the screen as a cerebral space
signs.q: Has the screen itself become a thinking system?

signs.name: Lectosigns
signs.gloss: the infinite of the time-image
signs.q: What must I read here that I cannot simply see?
signs.type: Lectosigns / the readable image (infinite of the time-image)

Two boys sparring: the fight rehearsed as play.
A figure in a dark doorway: welcome or threat.
A man beside his reflection: two images, neither simply first, as in Black Swan's mirrors.
An embrace that reads as comfort or as restraint.
Figures before a projected image: the real and its image changing sides.
A boy in the barber's mirror: the reflection returns the scene from another side.
A boy's face fills the frame: wonder held before any action.

shots.t: Eyes and Their Care (An Introduction), The
shots.note: An upturned child's face in tight close-up: the face as reflecting surface.
A woman at her mirror: the actual image and its virtual double, face to face.
A boy and his image in a hand mirror: the self doubled, each image an alternative.
Two faces mirroring each other: the double within one frame.
A woman opening a door onto darkness: an unmarked passage between worlds.
A family gathered still around the radio: hearing replaces doing. Audio analysis (heuristic): speech: likely narration.
A laid dining table: Boonmee's dinner, where the dead sit down with the living.
A woman repeating a kitchen chore: habit inscribed in the body.
A figure at a desk in lamplight: like the writer at the typewriter in The Secret in Their Eyes, the past pulling on the present.
A man at the door: the arrival implies a situation off-screen.
A body curled in rest: posture as thought.
A woman watching a television that shows another scene: an image within the image.
A curtained room with a lamp: domestic space where nothing happens.
A television set mid-broadcast: the screen doubled inside the screen.
An examination at a bedside: a look that infers what happened.
A bedridden woman holding a keepsake: the world pressed into an object.

shots.t: Letter From an Airline Pilot (Part I)
shots.note: A lecturer before a classroom diagram: the social order explained, as in marxism today's GDR classroom.
A man by a turntable: like Fish Tank's record, the world held in a charged object.
A man entering a room: the door opens onto the missing situation.
A young man brooding: the situation turned inward.

shots.t: Programmer with Magic Memory: Another Newsmaker
shots.note: A man dozing in an armchair: we can't tell when sleep began.
An official reading from a large book: Police, Adjective's dictionary scene, meaning fixed by ceremony.
A clerk at his ledger: the habitual entry, one more in the series.
A man slumped back in his chair: the body's fatigue before any act.
A man lying back, eyes closed: memory about to take command.
A man in profile beside a logic machine: thinking takes the place of acting.
An older man in an armchair, lost in reverie: the moment before the flashback.
An old man looking out over wetland: the seer who no longer acts.
A weathered old face: a lifetime of qualities written as surface.
